independence.review_basis: Exact rasters, neutral records, supplied minimal product context, Human-Eye V2.0 and Blind Jury v1.0 only.

jury_contract.selected_mode: Final independent jury; controller mode and total size not disclosed to this juror
jury_contract.mode_reason: Bounded final acceptance review assigned by controller
jury_contract.material_progress_status: Not compared; historical candidate intentionally unavailable

SOURCE_IDENTITY.basis: Supplied manifests plus verified 27 file hashes; no implementation read.

V2CoverageReceipt.REGION_COVERAGE: 9/9 complete document rasters, including all regions listed per capture

READABLE_VIEWS.method: All 9 original rasters and all 9 actual-pixel crop sheets opened and emitted with view_image. Native 45–70px avatar contours readable in original rasters.

EDGE_GATES.resolution: Each asset has LEFT RIGHT TOP BOTTOM resolution below. Intentional foreground modal occlusion is distinguished from clipped artwork; pixels control.

V2CoverageReceipt.APPLICATION_BINDING: WatchNest compiled Chromium synthetic UI, three states at 390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768. Full document rasters are 390x942, 768x1039, 1024x775. These are not native viewport-height screenshots. No horizontal document excess. At 390, Parent Mode crosses the native viewport bottom and footer lies below it; both are complete in document extent. Modal cards fit within native viewports.

HUMAN_GATES.alignment: PASS: centered headings/dialogs; card grid rows and label baselines align.
HUMAN_GATES.optical_centering: PASS: circular avatars and modal rocket balanced within carriers.
HUMAN_GATES.spacing_rhythm: PASS: consistent card spacing, internal rows and modal spacing; mobile wraps remain comfortable.
HUMAN_GATES.grouping: PASS: four profiles grouped as one selection task; parent action separated; PIN/error/cancel grouped in modal.
HUMAN_GATES.hierarchy: PASS: name/title and primary selection dominate; helper copy and status remain readable.
HUMAN_GATES.crop_story: PASS: profile glyph identities complete when exposed; modal foreground intentionally masks background.
HUMAN_GATES.contrast: PASS: active text and glyphs readable; dimmed background recedes; error remains legible. No numerical contrast audit claimed.
HUMAN_GATES.gestalt: PASS: coherent navy/lavender/peach family interface; restrained consistent components across sizes.

V2CoverageReceipt.FINAL_RESULT: CLEAN / PASS within supplied rendered scope
